TITLE: Edit Line – Adding a Technician to a Line Writes No History Entry
TYPE: Story Defect · PARENT: SV-10047 (Ready for QA, read 9 Oct 2026) · PRIORITY: Medium · LINK: relates to SV-10047 · LABEL: board-tech-view

h2. Description

A technician change made directly on a work order line *should be recorded in the history*.

For example,
* a user opens a line in the *Edit Line* window and adds a technician
* the change saves and the technician shows on the line
* nothing is written to the line's *Audit log* or to the work order's history

Lead changes are recorded correctly: each one writes one entry, and lines that move with the lead write none.

This appears inconsistent with the requirement defined in *Epic SV-10043* and the *PRD* (S4-R18).

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Open any work order that has a line.
# Click the line's name to open the *Edit Line* window.
# Under *Add Technician* pick a technician, then click *Save & Close*.
#* The technician now shows on the line.
# Open the line's menu (⋮) > *Audit log*.
#* There is no entry for the technician change.
# Open the work order's three-dots menu > *Audit Log*.
#* There is no entry for it there either.

*Actual Result:*
* Adding a technician in Edit Line saves, but no history entry is written for it.

*Expected Result:*
* The technician change made on the line is recorded in the line's history.
